basic_details.job_title: ATMA Simdega Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 Block Technology Manager, Assistant Technology Manager Posts
basic_details.post_name: Block Technology Manager, Assistant Technology Manager
basic_details.short_information: ATMA Simdega, Jharkhand, has invited applications for 15 posts in 2 roles. The posts include Block Technology Manager, Assistant Technology Manager. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Nationalized Bank Demand Draft payable at SIMDEGA.

age_limit.age_details: Below 45 years (as on publication of advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate or Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector with Computer Skill. Experience required: Minimum 2 years field experience in Agriculture Related activities. Age limit: Below 45 years. Pay: Rs. 30,000 per month. Qualification required: Graduate in Agriculture; Post Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector. Experience required: Preferably one year field experience in Agriculture Related activities. Age limit: Below 45 years. Pay: Rs. 25,000 per month.

exam_pattern.details: Cut off marks is 50 marks for Unreserved category and 40 marks for Reserved/Backlog categories Appearance in computer proficiency test is compulsory

how_to_apply: Download application format from www.simdega.nic.in or atmasimdega.co.in.
Attach self-attested copies of educational and other certificates.
Enclose a demand draft of Rs. 500 in favour of PROJECT DIRECTOR, ATMA, SIMDEGA.
Send the filled application by registered post or speed post to the office address.
Make sure it reaches by 25 November 2026.
important_instructions: Separate application must be submitted for each post Name of the applied post must be written on top of the envelope

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ATMA Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ATMA Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: 5 Block Technology Manager, 10 Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ATMA Simdega Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.simdega.nic.in / atmasimdega.co.in) and send it to Project Director, ATMA, Simdega, Block-B, Ground Floor, Collectorate, Simdega 835223, by registered post / speed post, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 45 years (as on publication of advertisement).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30,000 per month for Block Technology Manager, Rs. 25,000 per month for Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate or Graduate in Agriculture/Allied Sector. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Local residents of Simdega/Jharkhand will be given preference. No objection certificate required if working in any institution.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Academic qualification weightage. Computer knowledge test. Experience weightage. Document verification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial contract for one year, extendable yearly based on Performance Appraisal Report.
